name: palette-from-photo-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `paletteFromPhoto` flag (pro tier — `ui/paletteFromPhoto.ts:pickPaletteFromPhoto`, wired only as a Command Palette entry, `CommandPalette.tsx` COMMAND_FLAGS['palette-from-photo'] = 'paletteFromPhoto'). SCOPE NOTE (per the task brief): the full photo->palette->moodboard flow needs a REAL native file-picker round trip (`input.click()` on a detached `<input type=file>`, then reading the user-picked `File` in the `onchange` handler closed over that same local `input` — there is no dev hook exposing the handler or the input on `window`), which a headless Chromium session cannot drive (a `.click()` on a file input either hangs waiting for a dialog that never resolves, or Puppeteer's default no-dialog-handler auto-dismisses it with no `change` event either way) — confirmed by reading the implementation, not assumed. This rung is intentionally GATE-ONLY: it proves the Simple/Pro tier gate on the command's presence in the palette (the same technique `ai-surfaces-simple.json`/render-compare use), which is the part that IS cleanly drivable. The image-upload->extraction->moodboard round trip stays BLOCKED-NEEDS-HOOK — unit coverage of `extractPalette`/`mapPaletteToFinishes` (pure) already exercises the core logic; reviving full headless coverage would need a dev-only lever like `window.__pickPaletteFromPhotoBytes(bytes, mimeType)` that decodes a base64 image without the native file dialog (mirroring `__importSh3dBytes`) — flagged here, not built (out of scope for a coverage back-fill, no source edits).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); })()

steps.name: type-query-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const inp = document.querySelector('.cmdk-search input'); const target = inp || document.activeElement; if (!target) throw new Error('command palette input not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(target), 'value')?.set; if (setter) setter.call(target, 'Palette from photo'); target.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-command-absent-in-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cmdk-item')]; const hit = items.find(el => el.textContent.trim().includes('Palette from photo')); if (hit) throw new Error('paletteFromPhoto command should be hidden in Simple mode (pro tier)') })()
